_comment: Intentional per-marae differences for integrity-audit.js (repo-on-main vs one marae). Each entry suppresses exactly one (category, item, marae) finding from the FAIL criteria -- it is still computed and still shown in the check's evidence text (marked 'allowlisted'), just not counted as a failure. marae may be a project name from scripts/marae-registry.json, or '*' for every marae. Every entry needs a real, specific reason confirmed by direct investigation -- do not add one speculatively to silence a finding you have not actually looked at. This is deliberately separate from scripts/marae-registry.json's excluded_functions/excluded_jobs: that file controls what SHOULD be deployed/scheduled; this file controls which already-computed findings are expected and not worth re-flagging on every run.
